reference: She had been sprinting every morning for months before that final.
sk: Pred tým finále šprintovala každé ráno celé mesiace.
cz: Před tím finále sprintovala každé ráno celé měsíce.
acceptable: She had been {sprinting|running sprints} every morning for {months|many months|months on end} before {that|the} final.
Before {that|the} final she had been {sprinting|running sprints} every morning for {months|many months|months on end}.
She had been {sprinting|running sprints} for {months|many months|months on end} every morning before {that|the} final.
For {months|many months} before {that|the} final she had been {sprinting|running sprints} every morning.
Every morning for {months|many months} before {that|the} final she had been {sprinting|running sprints}.

mistakes.text: She was sprinting every morning for months before {that|the} final.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Dej trval dlho až do bodu v minulosti („before that final“), preto Past Perfect Continuous: „had been sprinting“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Děj trval dlouho až do bodu v minulosti („before that final“), proto Past Perfect Continuous: „had been sprinting“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The action lasted up to a past point (“before that final”), so use the Past Perfect Continuous: “had been sprinting”.

mistakes.text: She had sprinted every morning for months before {that|the} final.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Na dlhotrvajúci opakovaný dej pred minulým bodom sa lepšie hodí Past Perfect Continuous: „had been sprinting“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Na dlouhotrvající opakovaný děj před minulým bodem se lépe hodí Past Perfect Continuous: „had been sprinting“.
mistakes.feedback_en: For a long, repeated activity up to a past point, the Past Perfect Continuous “had been sprinting” fits better.

mistakes.text: She sprinted every morning for months before {that|the} final.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Na trvanie pred iným minulým dejom použi Past Perfect Continuous: „had been sprinting“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Na trvání před jiným minulým dějem použij Past Perfect Continuous: „had been sprinting“.
mistakes.feedback_en: To show duration before another past event, use the Past Perfect Continuous: “had been sprinting”.

mistakes.text: She has been sprinting every morning for months before {that|the} final.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Finále je už minulosť, preto nie „has been“, ale Past Perfect Continuous: „had been sprinting“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Finále už je minulost, proto ne „has been“, ale Past Perfect Continuous: „had been sprinting“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The final is in the past, so not “has been” but the Past Perfect Continuous: “had been sprinting”.

mistakes.text: She had been sprint every morning for months before {that|the} final.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „had been“ patrí tvar s -ing: „had been sprinting“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „had been“ patří tvar s -ing: „had been sprinting“.
mistakes.feedback_en: After “had been” you need the -ing form: “had been sprinting”.

mistakes.text: She had been sprinting every morning months before {that|the} final.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Pri trvaní chýba „for“: „for months“. Bez neho to znamená „mesiace pred finále“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: U trvání chybí „for“: „for months“. Bez něj to znamená „měsíce před finále“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Duration needs “for”: “for months”. Without it, it means the sprinting happened months before the final.
